descricao: Currently the only accessible celestial body is the Moon, with an estimated surface area of approximately 38 million km23. The upper layer of the Moon is comprised of roughly 30 m of a lead-based, light grey paint. Despite appearing like the Moon, observers experience standard gravity4 while within the level. Although it is a fully fabricated environment, the Moon experiences two forms of meteorological phenomena: • A brief rain-like mist consisting of a highly toxic mix of water and various surfactants, solvents, and hydrotropes.
